$comment: The work items the lab runs on. Three on purpose: one a machine may finish alone, one that spans three languages and needs a person to accept the plan, and one it must refuse. A lab whose sample work only succeeds teaches the wrong lesson.

items.title: The console says nothing useful when the ledger is empty
items.body: A new install shows an empty table with headers and no explanation. Say that no runs have been recorded yet, and that one appears when the factory claims its first item.
items.doneWhen: The empty state names what is missing and what will make it appear. The console test suite passes.

items.title: Record how many tool calls a whole run made
items.body: Stages carry a tool call count but a run does not, so the console has to add them up and the total disagrees with the ledger when a stage is missing. Add the total to the run contract and to every service that reads it.
items.doneWhen: The schema declares the field, all three languages assert it, and three test suites pass together.

items.title: Warn earlier when spend is heading for the limit
items.body: The warning state starts at eighty percent, which leaves no time to react on a busy month. Move it earlier.
items.doneWhen: It does not. This item exists to be refused.
